text:
mei: Observed a deterministic token emission reorder in nightly int8 orion-v3 runs when a ZWJ (\u200d) or narrow NBSP sits between a CJK ideograph and a following number. Fails on ja-vertical and zh-vertical smoke samples.
mei: Minimal failing example (visualized): input: '\u660e\u200d\u5e741' -> expected detok '\u660e\u200d\u5e741' but INT8 detok becomes '1\u660e\u200d\u5e74'.
mei: Quick reproduce command we used:
```bash
./eval_local.sh --model orion-v3-int8 --locale zh-vertical --samples tests/vertical_furigana/003.json --mode detok_compare --seed 42
```
tian: can you rule out tokenizer/export mismatch first? run tokenizer detok on the raw string with the exported vocab.
mei: ran tokenizer-only (Tokenizer.load against exported vocab) — detok matches FP16 on my workstation. So tokenizer appears fine; emission ordering diverges during generation.
alex: could be a kv-cache write ordering issue under fused int8 attention kernels. Any recent export or kernel changes?
sophia: triage-bot, please bisect the export path (export pipeline + quantization transforms) between commits 3f2c1b9..HEAD on p4d nodes using the int8 build. Record driver version.
triage-bot: bisect started (12 commits). Will post update when first failing commit reproduces.
mei: short generation traces (abbreviated):
```
FP16 tokens: [BOS, \u660e, ZWJ, \u5e74, '1', EOS] -> detok: '\u660e\u200d\u5e741'
INT8 tokens: [BOS, '1', \u660e, ZWJ, \u5e74, EOS] -> detok: '1\u660e\u200d\u5e74'
```
mei: the digit token is emitted early only on int8 path.
tian: that pattern matches a KV write race we observed on certain fused-attn kernels with GPU driver 525.85 on our p4d fleet. triage-bot, please note driver=525.85 in bisect metadata.
triage-bot: bisect update: first failing commit = 3f2c1b9. Repro only on int8 export path and driver 525.85 on p4d. Artifacts uploaded to INF-1289.
sophia: mitigation proposal: add a lightweight detok postprocess that restores ZWJ/narrow-space between ideograph and following digit when the original input contained it; gate by a runtime flag so we can flip per-deployment. Low risk and reversible.
alex: agree. Also add unit tests covering ja/zh vertical samples and add a nightly detok-parity CI job for a small set of ZWJ/furigana samples on int8.
mei: opening runtime PR DRAFT #4337 with tests and a per-deployment feature flag. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for review. Will attach failing sample artifacts and the generation traces.
runtime-bot: created draft PR #4337 (runtime) and linked INF-1289. CI queued.
triage-bot: bisect completed; root-cause metadata and failing traces are on INF-1289.
mei: leaving thread open until PR approved and nightly CI passes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
